title: Translation invariance of rectifiable varifolds with generalized mean curvature
statement: Let V = v(M, theta) be a rectifiable n-varifold in U, a subset of R^(n+l), and xi in R^(n+l); put tau(x) = x - xi. There is a rectifiable n-varifold V' in tau(U) with carrier tau(M), multiplicity y -> theta(y + xi), weight mu_V' equal to the image measure tau_# mu_V, and support spt V' = tau(spt V), such that whenever V has generalized mean curvature H in U, V' has generalized mean curvature y -> H(y + xi) in tau(U).
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (ξ : Amb n ℓ), ∃ V' : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ ((fun x => x - ξ) '' U), V'.carrier = (fun x => x - ξ) '' V.carrier ∧ (∀ y, V'.mult y = V.mult (y + ξ)) ∧ V'.weight = V.weight.map (fun x => x - ξ) ∧ V'.support = (fun x => x - ξ) '' V.support ∧ ∀ H : Amb n ℓ → Amb n ℓ, V.HasGeneralizedMeanCurvature H → V'.HasGeneralizedMeanCurvature (fun y => H (y + ξ))
